batch

Class MetadataScanner

  • java.lang.Object
    • batch.MetadataScanner
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Iterable<MediaRecord>

    final class MetadataScanner
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Iterable<MediaRecord>
    Discovers media files within a directory tree and extracts their metadata.

    Progress updates are broadcast to registered ProgressListener instances during scanning, providing real-time feedback without coupling the scanner to a specific user interface framework.

    Access Restriction: This class is intentionally declared final and package-private. It is an internal implementation class of the batch package and is not intended to be accessed or subclassed outside that package. The final modifier also prevents subclasses from extending or altering the scanner’s behaviour.

    throws BatchErrorException

      • countRegularFiles

        private long countRegularFiles()
                        throws java.io.IOException
        Counts the number of regular files within the configured source directory.

        The count is used to assist progress reporting prior to the metadata scan. The operation may terminate early if cancellation is detected.

        Returns:
        the number of regular files discovered
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - if an I/O error occurs while traversing the directory tree
